prompt: Implement the Strategy pattern: provide regular() and bulkDiscount() factory methods returning PricingStrategy implementations, and a total method that delegates the price calculation to whichever strategy it is given.
explanation: The Strategy pattern moves an algorithm (how to price an order) behind an interface so callers can swap it without changing Checkout. Because PricingStrategy has a single abstract method it is a functional interface, and each factory can return a lambda: regular() multiplies, while bulkDiscount() applies a 0.9 factor once the quantity reaches 10. total() never contains pricing logic itself -- it only delegates, which is why the test can even pass in its own custom lambda.
hints: PricingStrategy has exactly one abstract method, so a lambda like (q, u) -> ... can implement it.
bulkDiscount() computes the full total first, then returns full * 0.9 only when quantity >= 10.
total should contain no pricing math at all -- just return s.priceFor(qty, unit).
